summary: Identified circular dependency design flaw in provider onboarding cycle.
evidence: Identified cycle: Provider Vetting -> Admin Dashboard -> Provider Data -> Provider Vetting.

Root cause diagnosis: Conflation of data state ('pending application data submitted' vs 'active live provider data') and execution mechanism (complex admin dashboard UI vs lightweight approval script/API).
Analyzed why reordering cannot fix circular dependencies without redefining data lifecycle states.
